admission_arm: revl_gate::issue_admission(source) / issue_admission_into(source, manifest) -> Admission. `Admitted` requires BOTH that `admit` returned NoObjection and that the source is inside admission_surface; everything else is `Withheld` carrying the verdict verbatim. Against a non-empty manifest a candidate is admitted when nothing it declares redeclares a service the running composition declares, read off the item-186 wire's service block (`!services` + `:S` rows); a wire with no block makes no claim, so any declared service is withheld, and a wire carrying a withdrawal row is declined outright.
admitted_layer: interface declarations only: service method signatures and scalar type aliases, over a closed scalar type vocabulary; no term the reference type layer decides
covered_layer: composition + guarantee layer (G1..G4, A1, PRELUDE) and parse (BAD); NOT the reference type layer
emit_arm: revl_gate::emit_ir(ir_document, Tier::Rust) -> Result<String, Verdict>. A staged interchange IR document as JSON TEXT in, rust source out, with no Python and no reference compiler. Byte-agrees with backends/rust/emit.py over that backend's own self-host oracle corpus (tests/fixtures/emit_rust_corpus, 34 documents, no exclusions). It is not an admission and never reads `admitted:true`. `Tier::Py` fails closed: selfhost/emit_py.rvl's helper externs are @py-only. The FRONTEND is deliberately not in this path — `compile_to`, which would need one, still fails closed, because the self-host's lower_to_ir is behind the reference's (roadmap item 391).
manifest_arm: revl_gate::admit_into(source, manifest) — the item-186 ambient gate as a binding: the union fold's G2/G3 legs, the replacement wave's withdrawals and its `C=k:T` state hand-offs. Refuses a row it cannot read rather than skipping it, and issues no admission.
navigation_surface: revl_gate::symbols — declarations and their lines; issues no verdicts
note: Regenerate with `python3 tools/build_gate_crate.py`. The source_digest is a pure function of digest_inputs, not a git sha, so `--check` can verify the committed crate against the tree it was generated from. The VERDICT surface admits nothing, by construction: that surface decides the composition/guarantee layer, not the reference type layer, so its non-refusing arm is `no_objection` and never an admission — across the manifest boundary too. Admissions are issued only through the separate `Admission` surface, inside `admitted_layer`, where the covered layer is the whole question (issue #346).
